title: One
logline: One grease sack instead of two. The strip is about a bag.

panels.composition: The frame shop. WOOD cutting a mat. GULLY in the side door with ONE grease sack instead of two.

image.prompt: a thin man cutting a mat in a framing shop backroom, a stocky man in a rubber apron in the side door holding a single grease-stained paper sack

balloons.text: Your dad said he wasn't hungry.

image.prompt: close-up of a thin man looking at a single paper sack held out by another man, framing shop

panels.composition: Wood cutting. The blade goes off the line.

image.prompt: close-up of a utility blade skidding off the pencil line on a sheet of mat board, a hand gripping the knife

panels.composition: Gully sitting on the spackle bucket in the alley, eating from the one sack, holding it open toward Wood without looking at him. Wood still cutting. Rain. No words.

characters.pose: on a bucket, sack held open toward the door, not looking

image.prompt: wide shot of a man sitting on a spackle bucket in a rain alley holding an open paper sack toward a shop door where another man keeps working with his back turned, muddy early-digital flat colors

notes: Nothing says the father is sick. The afterword will.
